sources.ref: Topping Home web app v1.17.0 (https://home.toppingaudio.com/): the DX9 Discrete's session, its 10 configs and its settings

meta.notes: As topping-home. Up to 10 stored configs, which the bridge creates, renames and deletes as the app does, untried on a device. The firmware minimum is the one on Topping's page; the app itself checks no version for this device. The product name is a guess: the app tells its devices apart by a product name it strips of spaces and case, so the exact string a device reports is not known until one is read.
